name: Jinguuji Ren
source:
Ren is the third son of the Jinguuji family, making him rivals with Masato, whom he knows since he was little. He is very flirtatious, and plays the saxophone. However, his character runs deeper than the superficial.

He shares a room with Masato from Class A and is in Class S.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uta_no_Prince-sama#Main_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
